about.metaDescription: What %BRAND% is, what it will not do, and how to reach us.
about.title: About %BRAND%
about.lead: %BRAND% is a job-search tool for people who apply and hear nothing back. It shows what each job asks for that your resume doesn't, helps you fix it, and lets you practice the interview.
about.leadCn: %BRAND% is a job-search assistant for students and job seekers in mainland China: one profile, a deadline calendar for campus programmes, and AI interview practice.
about.rule1: Submit an application, or message an employer, for you.
about.rule2: Show a number without its source. Unknown is shown as unknown, never as zero.
about.rule3: Add experience to your resume that you haven't confirmed.
about.rule4: Present a fit score as your chance of getting hired.
about.rule5: Show testimonials, user counts or ratings we can't back up.
about.noEntity: Company details are listed in the terms of service.
about.contactBody: Questions, problems or feedback go to our support inbox:

security.metaDescription: How %BRAND% protects your account and data, in plain words.
security.title: Security
security.lead: What we actually do to protect your account and your data. If something here changes, this page changes with it.
security.account1: Passwords are stored only as salted one-way hashes. We can't read your password.
security.account2: Sign-in cookies can't be read by scripts on the page and travel only over encrypted connections.
security.account3: When your account signs in from a new browser or device, we email you.
security.account4: Sign-in attempts and other sensitive actions are rate-limited.
security.data1: You can download a copy of your data and delete your account from Settings.
security.data2: We never send an application, message or form to an employer for you.
security.data3: There are no third-party advertising pixels or trackers on %BRAND%.
security.aiIntl: Your resume and job data go only to the AI providers named in the privacy policy. They are never sent to AI services in mainland China.
security.aiCn: AI processing starts only after you turn it on, and you can turn it off at any time. Where data is processed and stored is stated in the privacy policy.
security.aiSensitive: Sensitive details such as a photo, birth date, gender or family members are never sent to an AI model.
security.reportBody: Email our support inbox with "Security" in the subject. Please don't test against other people's accounts:

help.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about %BRAND%, and how to contact support.
help.title: Help
help.sub: Answers to common questions. Can't find yours? Write to us below.

q1.q: How do I reset my password?
q1.a: On the sign-in page, choose Forgot password and follow the email we send.

q2.q: How do I cancel a subscription?
q2.a: In Settings under Billing, or without signing in on the cancel page. Access continues until the end of the period you paid for.

q3.q: Why did a job disappear from my list?
q3.a: It may have closed, been removed by its source, or been hidden by a filter you set. Closed jobs show when they were last seen.

q4.q: I opened an application but didn't apply. How do I fix it?
q4.a: Use Undo on the job, or change its status on your applications board.

q5.q: How do I delete my account?
q5.a: In Settings, under the account section. You can download a copy of your data first.

q6.q: Why does the fit score say it isn't my chance of getting hired?
q6.a: Because it only measures how well your resume lines up with the post. Hiring depends on many things we can't see.

ranking.metaDescription: Every factor %BRAND% uses to order the For you list, and what it never uses.
ranking.title: How ranking works
ranking.lead: The For you list (sort: Recommended) is ordered by four factors. Here is each one, with its weight.

fit.title: Fit to your resume and search
fit.body: Your fit score for the job, out of 100. When a full fit analysis isn't available yet, a quick estimate is used, counted slightly lower.

freshness.title: Freshness
freshness.body: Newer posts come first. The effect fades over about three days.

affinity.title: What you've shown interest in
affinity.body: Jobs like the ones you saved or opened move up; jobs like the ones you hid move down. Older actions count for less.

source.title: Listing source
source.body: Sources whose posts are usually complete and current count slightly more.

fitParts.title: What goes into the fit score
fitParts.tiers: Tiers: Great fit {great} and up · Good fit {good} to {goodTop} · Possible {possible} to {possibleTop} · Unlikely under {possible}.
fitParts.notChance: This is not your chance of getting hired.

ranking.rulesTitle: {count, plural, one {One more rule} other {More rules}}
ranking.pointsNote: Each job gets a ranking score out of 100 from the four factors. The rules and goals below add points to that score or move jobs within the list.
ranking.pointsNoteRules: Each job gets a ranking score out of 100 from the four factors. The rule below adds points to that score.

sponsorshipFirst.title: Visa sponsorship first
sponsorshipFirst.body: If you said you need visa sponsorship, jobs whose post mentions sponsorship come first, in the order you chose, and jobs whose post says it does not sponsor are hidden. This applies under every sort.

skillsBoost.title: Your chosen skills
skillsBoost.body: When skills are the only filter narrowing your list, jobs that ask for more of your chosen skills rank higher in Recommended, in proportion to how many of them the job asks for.

ranking.goalIntro: The career goal you chose when you set up your account adds points to jobs that match it.

goals.moreSenior: A more senior role: jobs above the lowest level you selected
goals.management: Managing people: jobs that manage people
goals.higherPay: Higher pay: jobs that list pay above your minimum, in the same currency
goals.flexibility: More flexibility: remote or hybrid jobs

ranking.goalOthers: Other goals do not change the order.
ranking.spread: No more than {max} jobs from the same company in any {window} in a row.
ranking.never1: Payment from employers. No one can pay to move a job up.
ranking.never2: Whether a job was posted by a recruiter. That is a filter only.
ranking.never3: Jobs flagged as possible scams are taken out of the list until they're reviewed.
ranking.never4: Your photo, age, gender or family details.
ranking.otherSorts: Newest, Best fit and Highest pay sort by that one thing only.
ranking.cnNote: On %BRAND%, if personalised recommendations are off or not chosen yet, jobs are ordered by date and your filters only.
